variations.name: Rush down
variations.description: The rush down at the start of lunch: about one person every 2.4 seconds, and most of them (65%) leave an upper floor for the lobby, while 15% still come up from the lobby and 20% move between upper floors. Cars fill on the way down and the upper floors queue, much like an evening rush but with some traffic in the other direction.

variations.name: Balanced, both ways
variations.description: The whole lunch hour averaged out: about one person every 2.4 seconds, 40% from the lobby up, 40% from upper floors down and 20% between upper floors, so cars are busy in both directions at once. This favors algorithms that handle both directions well.
